title: Three Nights
player_goal: Check in, survive three days, find a PG before the company stops paying.
design_goal: A safe base that expires — the first timer (reveal #5). Divya sets Monday.

cast.role: 'three nights only' — sets hotel_checked_in, starts the countdown

beats.what: Reception: company booking, three nights only. Countdown appears in the HUD.
Room. Phone rings — Divya: join Monday 9:30, find a PG, the hotel won't extend.
Bed: sleep → next morning 07:00, +30 health, food 70, one night spent. Autosave.
beats.reroute: three nights spent → checkout day; the PG hunt (P5) is the way out

acceptance: checking in shows 'Hotel: 3 nights left' in the HUD
entering the room opens Divya's call once
walking onto the bed sleeps: clock jumps to next day 07:00, health +30, nights left 2
exit returns to whitefield_street at hotel_door
